author: Michael Lepurage
text: My family has happily requested Affordable Septic Repair's services on more than one occasion. Every time, they were quick to respond, arrive, and resolve the issues. They also provided knowledgeable advice and tips for preventing further issues. We highly recommend them!

author: Cindy Fitzgerald
text: I highly recommend Affordable! Matt was very responsive! The team, consisting of Joseph, Matt, Travis and Joseph’s fiancé. She was so nice (I can’t remember her name….sorry!!) Everyone was very nice, professional, knowledgeable and got the job done timely and were very fair in the pricing. They fixed my yard back and it looked better than when they started. I give them ten stars!!!!

author: drew young
text: Matt was so quick to reply and fix our problem. Extremely knowledgeable and helpful during the whole process. He sent me photos throughout the day, I knew our project was in good hands. I already gave his number to one of my neighbors!

author: Don Conover
text: By chance I chose Affordable Septic Repair to fix an issue with my low pressure system. The pump was not working and needed repair asap. Along came Matthew from Affordable Septic Repair, he diagnosed the problem and corrected it in short order. They arrived and I was up and working in a short time. Very pleased with his excellent work and quick arrival. I highly recommend this first class operation and will use them in the future.

author: Jennifer Brown
text:
Affordable Septic Repairs did a fantastic job repairing our system today!  We called him this morning-  he said would be here today.  They arrived even quicker than we expected.   He figured out our problem and fixed it within an hour.   Very honest and nice people.   We highly recommend Matthew and his company.  Great service all the way around!
Scott and Jennifer Brown
